channel.title: Farsçadan (English)
channel.description: AI-assisted English translations of selected stories from Iran's Persian-language press. Every story notes the outlet's political orientation.

item.title: Erdoğan dismisses chief adviser Saral over Azerbaijan headscarf crisis
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Presidential chief adviser Oktay Saral, who criticized Azerbaijan's school headscarf ban, was dismissed on Sunday at Baku's request. (Source: Kayhan)

item.title: Four-way summit in Tehran: MIT chief Kalin meets Rezaei on regional security
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Top officials from Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan meet Iranian counterparts in Tehran to discuss regional security; talks end without consensus. (Source: Donya-ye Eghtesad)

item.title: Jordan's airstrikes on Syria's Dera: death toll disputed among sources
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Jordanian warplanes struck Syria's Dera province at night; a family home was hit, with death toll ranging from 8 to 10 according to sources. (Source: Hamshahri)

item.title: Oman FM: U.S. portrays Iran as threat, obstructs regional peace
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Oman's Foreign Minister Badr al-Busaidi says Gulf security cannot be achieved without Iran and that the U.S. is obstructing peace. (Source: Hamshahri)

item.title: Explosions in Dammam: King Fahd Airport suspends flights
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Explosion sounds reported in Dammam, eastern Saudi Arabia; King Fahd Airport suspends flights, according to FlightRadar data. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: CIA leak reveals claim: Israel asked Trump administration to kill Ghalibaf
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Leaked CIA documents claim Israel requested Trump kill Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf; Ghalibaf responds. (Source: Ettelaat)

item.title: Netanyahu and military chief Zamir clash over timing of Iran strike before elections
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Israeli PM Netanyahu and military chief Zamir disagree on timing of possible Iran attack before Knesset elections. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: Trump: Do we make a deal or finish them? Qatar mediation continues
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Trump says he'll either make a deal with Iran or "finish them"; Qatari mediators work to lower tensions before US midterms. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: Iraq's Cezabe border gate crisis: Prime Minister opens investigation into local official
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Iraq's PM launches investigation into Meysan official who gave Iran one week to reopen the Cezabe border gate. (Source: Hamshahri)

item.title: Sri Lanka evacuates 40 Iranian sailors from sanctioned tankers for medical treatment
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Sri Lanka evacuates 40 Iranian sailors from sanctioned tankers due to health concerns, provides medical care. (Source: Ettelaat)

item.title: Iran's target bank expands: Submarine internet cables in the Strait of Hormuz now on the list
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Lebanon's El Ahbar reported Iran will strike submarine internet cables in the Strait of Hormuz in a potential new war, alongside energy facilities. (Source: Donya-e Eqtesad)

item.title: Obama hits Trump hard on Iran war: Tehran now has a veto on the Strait of Hormuz
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Former U.S. President Obama criticized Trump's Iran war and economic management at Ohio rally; said Tehran holds veto over the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: Ettelaat)

item.title: Retired Turkish admiral Yaycı: If Turkey fights Israel, we will crush their army like insects
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Retired admiral Cihat Yaycı criticized Israel's "security map" targeting Syria; used threatening language about a hypothetical Turkey-Israel war. (Source: Ettelaat)

item.title: Kalabarg crisis grows: Stores reject the card when government doesn't pay its debts
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Because the government is not paying its kalabarg debts, many Iranian stores selling meat, poultry, and produce are no longer accepting the food voucher. (Source: Ettelaat)

item.title: Iran's defense ministers in history: Ahlaki became the oldest, four were martyred
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Of 15 defense ministers serving in 14 governments since the Revolution, four were martyred; new minister Mehrdad Ahlaki, 73, is the oldest to take office. (Source: Donya-e Eqtesad)

item.title: Fidan sends clear message from Istanbul summit: New attack would widen war
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: At the R4+E3 summit in Istanbul, Fidan and European counterparts stated agreement that a new attack on Iran would widen the conflict in the region. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: US Ambassador to Ankara Barrack: Attack on Iran this weekend is possible
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: US Ambassador to Ankara Tom Barrack said an attack on Iran this coming weekend is "absolutely possible"; Trump's messaging has been contradictory. (Source: Khabaronline)

item.title: Oil price exceeds $117: Hormuz tensions and Trump's conflicting messages
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Oil prices climb above $117 amid Strait of Hormuz tensions and concerns over possible US military action against Iran; Trump signals are mixed. (Source: IRNA)

item.title: Iran International: At least 79 executed in the month of Mehr
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: According to Iran International, the judiciary executed at least 79 people, including two women, on various charges during the month of Mehr. (Source: Iran International)

item.title: Tehran Education Department selling 10 properties: Vanak land could finance 70 new schools
item.dc:creator: AI Agent
item.description: Tehran Education Department prepares to sell 10 properties; a single parcel in Vanak Square could finance construction of 60-70 new schools. (Source: ISNA)
